title: Chalk Detective
objective: Describe the observable properties of chalk and choose its safe use or handling.
introduction: Hi Maxine! 🔍 Milo found a piece of chalk. Let's look closely: is it hard or crumbly? And how do we handle it safely?

Cotton cloth soaks up water, so it absorbs water.
Stone is firm and does not bend, so it is hard.

items.prompt: What property does a piece of chalk have?
items.explanation: Chalk is soft and dusty, so that is its property.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to learn about a material?

options.text: leave it out in the rain
look at it and touch it gently

items.explanation: Looking at it and touching it gently is safe. Tasting, throwing, or hitting materials is not safe.
